paragraphs: Rav Nechemya son of Rav [Huna] bar Chanilai.

[Eruvin 43b](https://www.sefaria.org/Eruvin.43b.16-17) relates that, absorbed in a halakhic discussion, he went beyond the Sabbath boundary on Shabbat. Rav Chisda told Rav Nachman: “Your student Nechemyah is in distress.”[^1]

[Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2660&lang=en) uses the longer name as his heading but says he did not find Rav Huna bar Chanilai and quotes the shorter name. Hyman reports that the Rif, Rosh and Dikdukei Soferim read Rav Nechemyah son of Rav Huna bar Chanilai. He proposes this as the reading on [44b](https://www.sefaria.org/Eruvin.44b.3).[^2]

notes.text: Eruvin 43b calls him Nechemyah son of Rav Chanilai. The linked 44b likewise lacks Huna and gives the two titles as Rabbi.
Heilprin quotes the shorter patronymic despite giving the longer form in his heading. Hyman reports the longer form from the Rif, Rosh and Dikdukei Soferim and proposes it at 44b.
